world.description: HUANGSHAN, China, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Huangshan Scenic Area has recently introduced Huangshan Yinglong: A Journey Through Mountains and Seas, an outdoor evening performance that uses the mountain landscape as its stage. Drawing on legends from the ancient Chinese text Classic of Mountains and Seas and on Huangshan’s local culture, the production combines live performance with an interactive procession to offer visitors a new way to explore the scenic area after dark.

science.title: Plants, people and progress for native prairie seeds
science.description: Native seed systems are a crucial part of prairie restoration and have been studied from ecological, production and trouble-shooting angles, but never from a social science perspective, until now. Researchers from South Dakota State University conducted more than 60 interviews to better understand the people and relationships within the native seed system of the Northern Great Plain Region to help identify the best ways to support the local network.

ai.description: izmo Microsystems and IIT Madras signed an MoU for Phase II of the ₹99.94 crore SPECTRA program. The five-year project targets 1.6 Tbps optical transceivers and co-packaged optics for AI infrastructure. MeitY contributes ₹97.54 crore while izmo Microsystems commits ₹2.40 crore in cash and in-kind support. The program aims to develop a volume photonics packaging ecosystem and Process Design Kit for 200 mm wafers.
